name: Gone quiet
title: Gone quiet: the morning brief names the companies and people you met regularly who have stopped meeting you, with nothing booked

events.wrote: You pressed Write to them on a company that has gone quiet, in the morning brief
events.put: You pressed Not now on a company that has gone quiet, in the morning brief

runs.shown: Rouh named a company you used to meet regularly that has gone quiet, in the morning brief

permissions: reads your main calendar's meetings of the last 180 days and the next 60 each time the morning brief opens
opens a new email in your own Gmail only when you press Write to them; nothing is written or sent by Rouh
keeps the lines you put away in your own settings
